extraction_notes: Curve points were read directly from the supplied PDF p. 2 plots and are not interpolated; the forward and capacitance traces are the SS2150~SS2200 and SS25~SS2200 family curves respectively, while the reverse trace is the SS28~SS2200 family curve.

All curve and specification values were converted to SI units where applicable: reverse current from microampere to A and capacitance from pF to F. The reverse-characteristics x-axis is preserved as percent of rated peak reverse voltage because that is the axis printed in the source.
The p. 1 table gives VRRM/VDC = 200 V, IF(AV) = 2.0 A, IFSM = 50 A at an 8.3 ms single half-sine wave, and operating junction temperature -55 to +150 degC for SS2200.
The p. 1 table gives a high-temperature reverse-current maximum of 3 mA at TA = 100 degC; it is not used as the fitted reverse-current specification.
No reverse-recovery time or measured breakdown-voltage/current characteristic is published in the supplied datasheet.

Fig.1 forward-current derating, Fig.5 non-repetitive surge current, and Fig.6 transient thermal impedance were not digitized because they are thermal or surge-rating curves rather than junction model characteristic curves.
